personSelection: Exactly one person annotation in source image, counting num_keypoints=0 and iscrowd annotations; chosen target is noncrowd.
primaryStratum: All four target joints v=2; v=1 cases retained separately as occlusion challenge, not declared incorrect.
targetCoordinateRequirement: All four target x/y coordinates lie inside original image pixel bounds.
noPersonAnnotationCaveat: Zero source person annotations does not prove a person-free image. Independent visual review required before using as person-free ground truth.
ranking: Ascending SHA256 of seed:image_id:annotation_id within positive strata, seed:no-person-annotation:image_id for no-person-annotation challenge. First calibration count per stratum goes to calibration, rest heldout.
selectionUses: Only official human annotations, image dimensions, published license metadata, fixed hash seed; no model scores, predictions, clips, fixtures, gate thresholds or acceptance results.
identityLimitation: COCO labels person instances, not persistent physical identities. Split is disjoint in source-image IDs and person-annotation IDs; physical-person identity across distinct photographs cannot be certified. Exact image-byte duplication is checked after download before inference.
